newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Beter Bed green shoe option exercised.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Beter Bed green shoe option exercised.

text.p: ABN AMRO Rothschild exercised a green shoe option on the issue of the Dutch furniture chain Beter Bed, given "very healthy demand" in the company's shares, both parties said in a statement on Tuesday.
The option increased the total number of shares involved in the issue by 601,397 to 4,610,713 and all shares were allocated on November 29, ABN AMRO said.
As the shares for the green shoe option were offered by the selling shareholders, the exercising would not lead to dilution, it added.
At the time of the listing, ABN AMRO said it had been granted this option by the selling shareholders to acquire an additional 600,000 shares up to 30 days after the payment date of December 5.
Shares in Beter Bed began trading on December 2.
